summary: We fix this problem like we fix all #literacies problems. Recognizing that it has always been a tool of oppression and the only way to escape the same oppression. Literacy is power. The web is power. We are teaching our children to be powerless in the face of social media.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We fix this problem like we fix all #literacies problems. Recognizing that it has always been a tool of oppression and the only way to escape the same oppression. Literacy is power. The web is power.

We are teaching our children to be powerless in the face of social media.
